---
title: "Top 23 Depression-Peddling Doomsayers"
date: "2010-07-02"
categories: ["Economics", "Financial Markets"]
---

[Business Insider](http://www.businessinsider.com/23-doomsayers-who-say-were-heading-toward-depression-in-2011-2010-5 "Business Insider") rounds-up the usual suspects. I agree with at least one of them: Tim Congdon. As I noted in this [op-ed](http://www.smh.com.au/business/bond-market-vigilantes-should-weigh-risks-of-continued-inactivity-20100412-s43b.html "op-ed") earlier in the year, bond markets were overstating inflation risks at the expense of the more likely scenario of continued ‘stimulus’-induced stagnation.
